pages.text: They needed spring water for tonight's soup. The spring was down the hill.
Lulu took a little water bottle. "I will fetch the water." The cousins each brought a bottle too.
Uncle Beppo brought a huge wooden water tub from the barn. "In our day, one tub did it all."
At the spring, he filled his tub. Lulu and the cousins filled their bottles.
Uphill, drops leaked from the tub's bottom, leaving a long wet trail.
At the yard, only a little water remained at the bottom.
"Well! It never leaked before." Uncle Beppo shook the tub. Just one cupful came out.
Pop! Lulu opened a bottle. Still full!
The cousins set their bottles in the kitchen, one by one, in a row.
Water poured into Mom's pot. Uncle Beppo gulped his one cupful. "The water tastes just like the old days!"
